title: laug · raun
description: One item and its cell: the signal against its max, the four windows, the six readings 1 m rolling, persistence, shards, roles, errors, the client's side and the cell's own pressure. Pick the cell; its gate and item follow from the gate's records. A lease outside a gate has no marks or windows (follow reads gate directories only). Titles say store (federated) or record (the gate's files). Times are UTC.

list.name: Windows: whole, drain and after
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (window) last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", edge="end"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000
list.titleFormat: {{window}}: whole and after judged, drain recorded

list.name: Window: during, recorded, not judged
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", window="during", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (item) last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", window="drain", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000

list.name: cell

query.query: query_result(max by (cell) (last_over_time(laug_item_info{cell!=""}[$__range]) or max by (cell) (last_over_time(up{job="laug-cells", cell!=""}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(1), "cell", "none", "", ""))

list.definition: query_result(max by (cell) (last_over_time(laug_item_info{cell!=""}[$__range]) or max by (cell) (last_over_time(up{job="laug-cells", cell!=""}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(1), "cell", "none", "", ""))

panels.title: Kill-history's signal (an item whose fault is kill-history; collapsed, since absence reads as 512)
Kill-history's signal: shards missing (store), 512 when the cell has no series
panels.description: faults/catalog.yaml's kill-history signal with one cell selector. It reads absence as 512 missing, as the catalog writes it: for a cell the store holds no series of, whatever its fault, it reads 512, so it sits in this collapsed row. Read it beside the first row's Federation target: 0 means the 512 is absence, not a reading. Dashed ember: the raun JSON's signal_max, drawn only when the item's fault is kill-history.

targets.expr: laug_fault_signal{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", field="max"} and on (gate_id, item) laug_item_info{gate_id="$gate", item="$item", fault="kill-history"}
